raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
### What does this PR do?

The three SFT e2e workflows list two entrypoint paths that no longer exist:

```yaml
      - "verl/trainer/fsdp_sft_trainer.py"
      - "verl/trainer/config/sft_trainer.yaml"
```

A `paths:` entry naming a missing file still parses and GitHub reports nothing — it simply never matches again.

The trainers these jobs actually run are `verl/trainer/sft_trainer.py` (spmd) and `verl/trainer/sft_trainer_ray.py` (ray), both selected in `tests/special_e2e/sft/run_sft_engine.sh`:

```bash
if [ "$mode" = "spmd" ]; then
  ENTRYPOINT=${ENTRYPOINT:-"-m verl.trainer.sft_trainer"}
else
  ENTRYPOINT=${ENTRYPOINT:-"-m verl.trainer.sft_trainer_ray"}
fi
```

and both load `sft_trainer_engine.yaml`, not `sft_trainer.yaml`:

```python
@hydra.main(config_path="config", config_name="sft_trainer_engine", version_base=None)
```

**Scoping the actual impact, because it's narrower than it first looks.** These blocks start with `**/*.py`, and GitHub applies path filters in order with last-match-wins, so I simulated the ordered list rather than assuming:

| changed file | triggers before | triggers after |
|---|---|---|
| `verl/trainer/sft_trainer.py` | ✅ | ✅ |
| `verl/trainer/sft_trainer_ray.py` | ✅ | ✅ |
| `verl/trainer/config/sft_trainer_engine.yaml` | ❌ | ✅ |

The two `.py` files are already covered by the leading `**/*.py`, and no later negative entry excludes them. So the **real** gap is the config: `sft_trainer_engine.yaml` is 85 lines of live training config (batch sizes, `use_dynamic_bsz`, engine/optim defaults) that these three jobs load on every run, and today it matches no entry at all — editing it runs none of them.

I'd rather state that precisely than oversell it. Repointing the `.py` entries is then mostly about the block saying what it means, instead of naming two deleted files.

### Checklist Before Starting

- [x] Search for similar PRs: [`is:pr fsdp_sft_trainer`](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=repo%3Averl-project%2Fverl+is%3Apr+fsdp_sft_trainer) — nothing covering this. This is a narrowed resubmission of my own #7825, see the note at the bottom.
- [x] Format the PR title as `[{modules}] {type}: {description}` — validated with `tests/special_sanity/check_pr_title.py`.

### Test

```
$ # all workflows still parse
47 workflows parsed, 0 failures

$ # parsed-level check of the changed trigger lists
e2e_sft_llm.yml / e2e_sft_llm_ascend.yml / e2e_sft_vlm.yml
  -> positive entries now name sft_trainer.py, sft_trainer_ray.py,
     config/sft_trainer_engine.yaml
  -> negative exclusions unchanged (diff contains 0 lines touching them)

$ # each replacement target verified present on current main
verl/trainer/sft_trainer.py                    EXISTS
verl/trainer/sft_trainer_ray.py                EXISTS
verl/trainer/config/sft_trainer_engine.yaml    EXISTS
verl/trainer/config/sft_trainer.yaml           GONE
verl/trainer/fsdp_sft_trainer.py               GONE
```

I also simulated GitHub's ordered last-match-wins evaluation over the full 12-entry list to produce the before/after table above, rather than reasoning about the entries in isolation — that's what showed the `.py` entries were already covered and kept me from overstating the fix.

Diff is 9 lines across 3 files. No job logic, step, runner or matrix changed.

### API and Usage Example

N/A — CI trigger configuration only.

### Design & Code Changes

`e2e_sft_llm.yml`, `e2e_sft_llm_ascend.yml`, `e2e_sft_vlm.yml`: in the positive `# Entrypoints` block only, replace the two dead paths with the two real trainers and the config they load.

### Checklist Before Submitting

- [x] Read the Contribute Guide.
- [x] Apply pre-commit checks — YAML-only change; all 47 workflows parse and I diffed the trigger lists at the parsed level.
- [ ] Add / Update the documentation — not applicable, no user-facing behaviour change.
- [ ] Add unit or end-to-end test(s) — not applicable to a trigger-path fix. I did write a general guard for this class of rot, but deliberately left it out here to keep the diff reviewable; happy to open it separately if you'd want it.
- [ ] Send a message in the `ci-request` channel — worth doing for this one, since it changes when these three GPU e2e jobs fire. I don't have Slack/Feishu access, so I can't request it myself. As a first-time contributor my runs are also gated behind **"Approve and run workflows"**.
- [ ] Not related to the `recipe` submodule.

---

**Relationship to #7825.** That PR was closed on 15 Sep without review — it touched 22 workflows and 49 entries at once, which I think was simply too much surface for one review. This is the smallest independently-useful slice: 3 files, positive entries only, no new hook, and no changes to the `vllm`/`sgl` entries I'd previously judged myself.

The rest of what #7825 covered is still present on `main` (41 stale entries across 22 workflows, mostly `!verl/trainer/fsdp_sft_trainer.py` exclusions that have quietly become no-ops). I'm happy to send those as follow-ups in similarly small batches if this shape works for you — or to leave them alone if you'd rather not churn the workflow files.

Assembled with AI assistance; every count, table and path check above is from a local run against current `main`.
